main.description: Phase P2 of ADR-2605212030 — mirror a vendor-issued ERC725 root (`did:erc725:etzhayyim:260425:*`) into an etzhayyim root on Base L2. Caller proves control of the existing vendor root by signing a continuity digest with their original vendor signing key. Council verifies the proof off-chain and submits EtzhayyimAuthz.mirrorVendorRoot. Returns the new etzhayyim DID + tx hash. This procedure is opt-in per actor; vendor roots stay valid for historical queries until vendor deprecation.

dwebHandle.description: Public handle to bind to the new etzhayyim root.

newActiveKey.description: 0x-prefixed 20-byte address that will own the new etzhayyim root. MAY be the same as the vendor key or different.

vendorRootDid.description: Full vendor DID being mirrored, e.g. `did:erc725:etzhayyim:260425:0xabc...`.

vendorAddr.description: 0x-prefixed Ethereum address of the vendor signer (EOA or smart-wallet).

vendorContinuityProof.description: 0x-prefixed signature by vendorAddr over `keccak256("etzhayyim-vendor-continuity" || vendorRootDid || dwebHandleHash || newActiveKey)`.

vendorRootHash.description: 0x-prefixed keccak256 of `vendorRootDid` — recorded on-chain in predecessorVendorRootHash.

errors.name: DwebHandleTaken
errors.description: dwebHandle already bound to an active root.

errors.name: VendorContinuityProofInvalid
errors.description: vendorContinuityProof does not recover to vendorAddr.

errors.name: VendorRootUnknown
errors.description: vendorRootDid does not match any known vendor-issued root.

errors.name: CouncilApprovalRequired
errors.description: the Council multisig has not yet approved this mirror request.
